unit.why: A homiletic Yiddish gloss on the Unetaneh Tokef piyyut, pleading for Israel against the nations. It is attributed to the tsaddik 'once while reciting' but has no narrative event beyond the saying itself.
unit.boundary_note: part of a series of sayings on Unetaneh Tokef / High Holiday liturgy, (יג)–(טו)
